## State of Birds

- Regular status assessments of a region's birds
- Limited to few parts of the world (**Global North**)
- Large-scale systematic monitoring programmes (**structured data**)

## The SoIB Partnership {background-image="pics/soib_logo.png" background-size="10%" background-position="top right"}

::: {.incremental}

- Provide **best current knowledge** on status and conservation of India's birds
- **Curating, analysing, and synthesizing available information** to bring out **variety of knowledge products** for use by policymakers, managers, researchers, conservationists, media, and other stakeholders
- Products **freely available**, and represent **state-of-the-art knowledge** on species, habitats, locations, and threats

:::

![](pics/foss_meme.jpg){fig-align="center" height=250 .fragment}

## The SoIB Partnership {background-image="pics/soib_logo.png" background-size="10%" background-position="top right"}

- Provide **best current knowledge** on status and conservation of India's birds
- **Curating, analysing, and synthesizing available information** to bring out **variety of knowledge products** for use by policymakers, managers, researchers, conservationists, media, and other stakeholders
- Products **freely available**, and represent **state-of-the-art knowledge** on species, habitats, locations, and threats
- Identify **critical gaps in knowledge** for effective bird conservation in India

## {background-image="pics/soib_pipeline.jpg" background-position="center" background-color="white" background-size="contain"}

##

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}

- Approach different from eBird Status & Trends
- Data *curation before modelling*
- Spatial random effects in GLMMs
- Strict sensitivity checks
- Three-way priority classification
- Replicable blueprint!

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
![](pics/soib_pipeline.jpg){fig-align="right" style="box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 0px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 10px;" height=800}
:::

## SoIB 2027 sneak peek!

- Analytical improvements: subsampling, checklist centroids, hex-grids
- Data improvements: species attributes
- Data gaps: species, space, habitat, scale ?
- Conservation across space: habitats, protection, urbanisation
- Metrics for conservation: NRL, WPE, WLPA, Wild Bird Index ?
- Demography
- Deeper dives: threats & policy
- ... and more!
